answer:
I don't know what the default is in Ollama 0.32.10 and later. I have no reliable information about that release or any change to its default repeat penalty, and I haven't seen a changelog for it in this project.

Historically, Ollama's documented default for `repeat_penalty` has been 1.1 (with `repeat_last_n` at 64). If 0.32.10 changed how models without their own setting are handled, I can't confirm what the new value is.

To check, you could look at the 0.32.10 release notes on the Ollama GitHub releases page, or at the default options in the source (`api/types.go`, in `DefaultOptions()`). If you have the source checked out here, I can search it.
